FINDING N8
results.detail: refused on the devnet-build Swig build (0 lamports reached the attacker). Swig forwards outer signers into the inner call and its Program action only checks instructions that sign with the Swig wallet; this build also checks that outer signers' balances do not fall. The relayer rule (never list the relayer key in an instruction) stays.

results.detail: with the owner as role 0, the 7-day cap binds the session key and not the owner (the owner can add a longer role). The frozen variant below removes that.

results.name: H3a. an attacker creates a Swig at the id the app meant to use, with the attacker as root
H3b. the app creates its Swig at the same id
H3c. the squatted Swig is owned by the attacker, so the app must read role 0 before the 2-of-3 lists a wallet address
H4a. frozen variant: one transaction creates the Swig with a throwaway root key E, adds the owner session role, and replaces E with the vault address
H4b. role 0 is now the vault address, not E
H4c. E can no longer add an authority
H4d. the owner cannot add a longer role (it holds no admin role)
H4e. the 2-of-3 cannot act as the admin either: Swig refuses any admin call that arrives by CPI
H4f. the owner still starts sessions on the frozen Swig
H4g. the frozen Swig keeps the maximum from the first transaction
H4h. frozen Swig: the session key removes its own role
H4i. ...then the owner cannot start a session any more, and nobody can add the role back: the 2-of-3 must replace the Swig (new Swig, policy update)
